newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka stocks ease on second day on correction.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka stocks ease on second day on correction.

text.p: Sri Lanka stocks were driven down for the second straight day this year, on profit-taking by small investors, brokers said.
The all share index closed 3.51 points down at 629.29. Price falls outnumbered gains by 39 to five.
Cold Stores fell one rupee to 80, Lanka Ceramic two to 33.
"The market correction should continue, since there is more profit to take," said Gordon Nadesan, a trader at CT Smith Stock Brokers.
The index could fall close to 615 points, before buying returns, brokers said.
"Though there may be no more profits when the index comes to about 620 points, some investors will panic and sell," said Subram Ramasamy, deputy general manager of Batleet Mallory Stock Brokers.
Turnover was 21.4 million rupees on 584,908 shares, led by domestic activity.
Foreign buying was 9.5 million rupees, led by 28,200 Development Finance, which was three rupees up at 275.
